entities.summary: Gerhard Unterluggauer is an Austrian former professional ice hockey defenceman who Captained EC VSV in the Austrian Hockey League (EBEL). He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Austria men's national ice hockey team. He also competed at the 1998 Winter Olympics, the 2002 Winter Olympics and the 2014 Winter Olympics.
